reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to EUR 120 million for the account of EBRD to be provided as part of a total financing package of up to EUR 750 million alongside a consortium of commercial banks in favour of Heimstaden Czech s.r.o and Heimstaden Czech Pilsen s.r.o (the "Borrowers"), limited liability companies organised in Czechia both fully owned by Heimstaden Bostad AB ("Heimstaden" or "the Parent"). The proceeds of the EBRD loan will fund sustainability capex in the Borrowers' residential buildings in Czechia and recapitalisation of the Borrowers. The transaction will support energy efficiency improvements in the residential real estate sector in Czechia. It is the first large scale and systemic renovation of a private portfolio of buildings implemented in Czechia.
